technical.summary: Overbought short-term technicals (RSI-9 extreme, stoch bearish cross) conflict with bullish structure; weak ADX and low volume ratio undermine conviction despite Ichimoku cross-up and new highs.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 25 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 335 crisis level, rising DXY, NFP event today, macro_score -8) creates severe headwinds for Energy sector; earnings in 25 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud cross-up, price at 52-week highs, and extreme fear sentiment (18/100) create a contrarian long setup with defined support at 98.73.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought technicals (RSI-9 88.62, stoch bearish cross), zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX spike, NFP today), and weak volume ratio make this a high-risk fade into resistance.

decision.entry_rationale: Ichimoku cross-up and price at 52-week highs offer contrarian appeal in extreme fear environment, but entry quality is severely compromised by overbought technicals and macro crisis conditions.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, NFP event today) combined with RSI-9 extreme overbought (88.62) and stochastic bearish cross create high probability of sharp pullback before earnings in 25 days.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical overbought, fundamental absent, macro hostile, sentiment contrarian but weak conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 26 Energy positions and existing MPC position; sector concentration and earnings proximity (25 days) demand strict position discipline; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows flexibility but macro environment argues against adding exposure.
